### Intro

Hi! I use MuJoCo for robot simulation and compose scenes from MJCF files with `<asset><model>` and `<attach>`.

### My setup

MuJoCo 4.0.1 from PyPI, and `main` at 8148157 built from source. Python and C APIs, Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.

### What's happening? What did you expect?

A model file whose `<model>` asset names the file itself, or two model files that name each other, crash the process with a segmentation fault instead of failing with an error. Declaring the asset is enough; no `<attach>` is needed. It happens with `mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path` and `mujoco.MjSpec.from_file`, and in C with `mj_loadXML` and `mj_parseXML`.

Why (`main` at 8148157; 4.0.1 is the same):

- The `<model>` branch of `mjXReader::Asset` parses the referenced file with `mj_parse` ([`xml_native_reader.cc` L2036-L2047](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/81481572af0311f3a9516551cbdb493c981d3a47/src/xml/xml_native_reader.cc#L2036-L2047)), which passes `.xml` files to `mj_parseXML` ([`user_api.cc` L87-L91](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/81481572af0311f3a9516551cbdb493c981d3a47/src/user/user_api.cc#L87-L91)). `ParseXML` then reads that file with a new `mjXReader` ([`xml.cc` L367](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/81481572af0311f3a9516551cbdb493c981d3a47/src/xml/xml.cc#L367) and [L292-L299](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/81481572af0311f3a9516551cbdb493c981d3a47/src/xml/xml.cc#L292-L299)). Nothing records which files are already being parsed, so a file that leads back to itself recurses until the stack overflows.
- `<include>` has a guard for this: `ExpandIncludeXML` keeps the set of included files and fails with `File '...' already included` ([`xml.cc` L121-L124](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/81481572af0311f3a9516551cbdb493c981d3a47/src/xml/xml.cc#L121-L124)).
- The `attach` docs list "Circular references are not checked for and will lead to infinite loops" as a known issue ([`XMLreference.rst` L4103-L4109](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/81481572af0311f3a9516551cbdb493c981d3a47/doc/XMLreference.rst?plain=1#L4103-L4109)). This case fails earlier, in the parser, and the crash takes down the calling process (a Python interpreter, for example) instead of raising an error it can catch.
- `mju_getXMLDependencies` has the same recursion over model files ([`xml_util.cc` L305-L310](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/81481572af0311f3a9516551cbdb493c981d3a47/src/xml/xml_util.cc#L305-L310)); #3825 addresses that part.

Expected: an error that names the file, as `<include>` gives for a repeated file.

### Steps for reproduction

1. Save the script below as `repro.py`.
2. `pip install mujoco==4.0.1`
3. Run `python repro.py hand.xml` (a file that names itself) and `python repro.py a.xml` (two files that name each other). Both end with `Segmentation fault` (exit code 139) before printing `loaded`.

### Minimal model for reproduction

<details>
<summary>hand.xml: names itself</summary>

```XML
<mujoco>
  <asset>
    <model name="self" file="hand.xml"/>
  </asset>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="palm"><geom size="0.1"/></body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>a.xml and b.xml: name each other</summary>

```XML
<!-- a.xml -->
<mujoco>
  <asset>
    <model name="b" file="b.xml"/>
  </asset>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="a"><geom size="0.1"/></body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>
```

```XML
<!-- b.xml -->
<mujoco>
  <asset>
    <model name="a" file="a.xml"/>
  </asset>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="b"><geom size="0.1"/></body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>
```
</details>

### Code required for reproduction

```python
import os
import sys
import tempfile

import mujoco

FILES = {
    # hand.xml names itself
    "hand.xml": """
<mujoco>
  <asset>
    <model name="self" file="hand.xml"/>
  </asset>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="palm"><geom size="0.1"/></body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>
""",
    # a.xml and b.xml name each other
    "a.xml": """
<mujoco>
  <asset>
    <model name="b" file="b.xml"/>
  </asset>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="a"><geom size="0.1"/></body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>
""",
    "b.xml": """
<mujoco>
  <asset>
    <model name="a" file="a.xml"/>
  </asset>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="b"><geom size="0.1"/></body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>
""",
}

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
for name, xml in FILES.items():
  with open(os.path.join(d, name), "w") as f:
    f.write(xml)

print(mujoco.__version__, sys.argv[1], flush=True)
mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(os.path.join(d, sys.argv[1]))
print("loaded")
```

### Confirmations

- [x] I searched the [latest documentation](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html) thoroughly before posting.
- [x] I searched previous [Issues](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/discussions), I am certain this has not been raised before.
new_candidates.title: Segfault on recursive `<model>` assets: a model file that names itself, or two that name each other
